items.originalTitle: Oliver Bearman explains why Haas’ 2026 F1 car is ‘hitting its ceiling’
items.summaryEn: Oliver Bearman believes Haas cannot extract much more performance from its 2026 Formula 1 car, after showing encouraging Friday pace at the United States Grand Prix but qualifying only 16th.
detailZh: 贝尔曼解释哈斯2026年F1赛车为何“已触及上限”
在贝尔曼看来，VF-26几乎完美——只是下压力不足，且无法解决
贝尔曼认为，在美国大奖赛之后，哈斯无法从2026年F1赛车中榨取更多性能。
贝尔曼在美洲赛道展现了令人鼓舞的周五速度，前两节自由练习分别排名第11和第10，但随后排名下滑，排位赛仅列第16位。
这位英国车手解释说，这是因为早在第一节练习赛（FP1）就找到了近乎完美的调校，这意味着随着对手在这方面取得进展，他的VF-26赛车相对竞争对手失去了速度。
“这表明我们作为一个团队做得很好，”他说。“基本上，我们从第一节练习赛开始就充分发挥了赛车的潜力。我告诉你，整个周末我们只把车身高度调整了一毫米。从我起步时到比赛时用的车？同一辆车。
“因为它很好。因为它很棒。从我在第一节练习赛第一次装上软胎开始，在第一节练习赛的汇报中，我就想，‘我不知道这辆车还需要什么’。它非常非常好。我的意思是，平衡很好，感觉很好。我们只是下压力不够。所以感觉不错，但我们就是没有别人那么快。”
哈斯车队受制于近两个月前意大利大奖赛引入的最新重大升级套件。自那以后，除了雪邦赛道专用的后部碰撞结构外，没有引入任何新部件。
贝尔曼继续说道：“我并不惊讶于我们与领先者之间的相对差距保持不变，而其他所有人都设法提升并超越了我们。这意味着我们有一辆可预测的、温和的赛车。特性非常好，但我们就是没有足够的下压力，而且很明显：随着圈数增加，即使在排位赛中，竞争力也会变差，因为我们就是会毁掉轮胎，无法保持住它们。
“这令人沮丧，但与此同时，我们还能期待什么呢？我们的竞争对手本周末又带来了升级。我的意思是，他们带来的升级大约是我们的三到四倍。所以我不惊讶于我们被他们所有人超越，他们的赛车比我们快。
“这就是为什么我并不真的后悔对皮埃尔采取那个决定。因为我知道，如果那没有发生，我就只能跟在他后面，最终可能被奥迪超越，而那不是我在这里要做的事。我需要得分，这就是我们作为车队需要做的。是的，我们最终需要一辆更快的赛车。”
那么VF-26不会再有更多升级了吗？“不幸的是没有，”贝尔曼说。“不，它已经达到上限了。”
“如果我只是自己开着车转悠，我会觉得‘啊，这车感觉很不错’。如果我把它与大概三四场比赛前的感受相比，特性已经改善了很多。然而，负载就是负载，下压力就是下压力，而我们缺少下压力。”
然而，队友埃斯特班·奥康可能不同意关于VF-26所谓舒适表现的看法，这位法国车手在奥斯汀比赛后抱怨刹车不一致。
“这出现在排位赛中，当您把车推到极限时，”奥康详细说道。“当轮胎性能下降时，我需要提前10-15米刹车，而且我仍然会出现很多锁死和很多转向不足。这不是一种很好的感觉，相当不可预测。整个周末都存在这个问题，所以我们将其最小化了，我认为这相当积极；与工程师们一起，我们设法让它稍微更受控制，但根本问题仍然存在。”
这位老将在美国大奖赛中艰难地获得第14名，距离积分区有34秒之差。
detailEn: Oliver Bearman explains why Haas’ 2026 F1 car is ‘hitting its ceiling’
From Bearman’s point of view, the VF-26 is all but perfect – other than an insurmountable lack of downforce
Oliver Bearman believes Haas cannot extract much more performance from its 2026 Formula 1 car, following the United States Grand Prix.

Bearman displayed encouraging Friday pace at the Circuit of The Americas, with 11th and 10th in the opening two free practice sessions, before slipping down the order – to the extent that he qualified just 16th.
The Briton explained this was down to finding a near-perfect set-up as early as FP1, meaning his VF-26 lost pace relative to the competition as his rivals made inroads on that front.

“It shows that we're doing a good job as a team,” he said. “We're getting the most out of our car from FP1, basically. We had a car that we really changed the ride height, I tell you, by one millimetre the whole weekend. From where I started to where I raced the car? Same car.

“Because it was good. Because it was great. From the first time I put the soft tyre in FP1, in my FP1 debrief, I was like, ‘I don't know what else I need from the car’. It's very, very good. I mean, the balance is good, it's feeling good. We just don't have enough downforce. So it feels good, but we're just not quite as quick as others.”

Haas is held back by its latest substantial upgrade package dating back to the Italian Grand Prix, nearly two months ago. Since then, no new parts have been introduced other than a Sepang-specific rear impact structure.

“I'm not surprised that we kept the same relative gap to the leaders and everybody else just managed to improve and overtake us,” Bearman continued. “It means that we have a kind of predictable, benign car. The characteristics are very good, but we simply don't have enough downforce, and it's very clear: as the lap goes on, even in qualifying, the competitiveness gets worse because we just kill the tyres and we can't hold on to them.

“It's frustrating, but at the same time, what else can we expect? Our competitors brought upgrades again this weekend. I mean, they brought like three or four times more upgrades than we have. So I'm not surprised that we're getting outdone by all of them, they have faster cars than us.

“That's why I don't really regret the decision to go for it on Pierre. Because I know that if that doesn't happen, I'm just going to follow him around and eventually get overtaken probably by the Audis, and that's not what I'm here to do. I need to score points and that's what we need to do as a team. Yeah, we need a faster car at the end.”
So will nothing more come from the VF-26? “Unfortunately not,” Bearman said. “No, it's hit the ceiling.

“If I was just driving around by myself, I would be like, ‘Ah, the car feels very nice’. If I compare it to how it felt maybe three or four events ago, the characteristics have improved a lot. However, load is load, downforce is downforce, and we lack it.”
Yet, team-mate Esteban Ocon might disagree about the VF-26’s alleged comfortable behaviour, with the Frenchman complaining of braking inconsistency following the Austin race.

“It comes in quali when you push the car to its limits,” Ocon detailed. “And when the tyre takes off, I need to anticipate braking 10-15 metres and I still do pick up a lot of locking and a lot of understeer. It's not a very nice feeling, it's quite unpredictable. It's been there all weekend, so we minimised it, which I think was quite positive; with the engineers we managed to get it a little bit more under control, but the underlying problem is still there.”
The veteran struggled to 14th in the US GP, 34 seconds away from the points-scoring positions.

items.originalTitle: McLaren plan further upgrades after Austin struggles
items.summaryEn: McLaren have confirmed they will continue to bring upgrades to their car in the closing stages of the 2026 Formula 1 season after struggling to compete at the front in Austin.
detailZh: 墨西哥城大奖赛：迈凯伦计划进一步升级，此前兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在奥斯汀表现挣扎
迈凯伦已确认将在2026年F1赛季收官阶段继续升级赛车；大多数车队已停止本赛季赛车研发，将重心转向2027年；本周五起，天空体育F1将直播墨西哥城大奖赛的每一节练习与排位
克雷格·斯莱特点评美国大奖赛：梅赛德斯的基米·安东内利强势夺冠，这位意大利车手只需在墨西哥大奖赛拿到两分，就能夺得历史性的首个世界冠军
迈凯伦计划在2026年F1赛季剩余分站继续为赛车带来升级，此前他们在近几站难以在前列竞争。
自从兰多·诺里斯上个月在马德里错失胜利以来，迈凯伦在最近四场比赛中都未能登上领奖台，尽管在此期间为赛车带来了新部件。
在上周末美国大奖赛排位赛获得第八名后，诺里斯将MCL40描述为“我一生中开过的最难驾驭的赛车”。

诺里斯在比赛后段采用备选的一停策略一度升至第二位，但随后被夏尔·勒克莱尔、马克斯·维斯塔潘和刘易斯·汉密尔顿超越，跌至第五，而奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里以第七名完赛。
“还会有更多东西到来，”车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉在谈到迈凯伦的升级计划时表示，鉴于大多数车队目前都在专注于设计2027年的赛车。
“我认为最终我们只能在巴西和拉斯维加斯两站进行升级。所以墨西哥站不会有太多，但巴西和拉斯维加斯会有一些升级。”
“希望这能帮助我们在争夺领奖台的战斗中保持稳定，并希望能开始接近争夺胜利所需的竞争力水平。所以，还有一些升级仍在筹备中。”
夏尔·勒克莱尔在奥斯汀对兰多·诺里斯和马克斯·维斯塔潘完成两次精彩超越
迈凯伦在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛前的新闻稿中确认，车队“仍致力于在每个机会中学习、开发并最大限度地挖掘MCL40的潜力”。
他们补充道：“在奥斯汀成功引入MCL40前后角改动后，本周末的比赛赛车基本保持不变。”
因此，通过车队的研发路径，只有少量部件会被送到墨西哥城赛道，而2026赛季剩余分站的进一步升级已在筹备中，从圣保罗站开始。
诺里斯指出排位赛是弱点
诺里斯今年在布达佩斯、赞德沃特和马德里拿到了三个杆位，但在这些排位赛中，他与第二名之间的最大差距仅为0.102秒。
整个赛季中，这辆赛车似乎一直处于极限边缘，皮亚斯特里在这方面挣扎得更多，而诺里斯表示低速弯对车队来说也是一个问题。
诺里斯告诉天空体育F1：“有很多场比赛我们都表现出色，做得非常好。但在排位赛中我们一直很挣扎。”
诺里斯承认他在奥斯汀排位赛中表现“糟糕透顶”，并表示迈凯伦是他开过的“最难驾驭的赛车”。
“我们大致知道需要在哪些方面改进赛车。我认为在奥斯汀很明显，我们在低速弯每圈几乎损失了零点三秒，每一圈都是如此。如此持续地损失这么多圈速，可不是小数目。
“我们需要在特定区域进行改进。如果我们能做到这一点，我非常有信心我们能取得一些好成绩，但对我们来说，要想达到我们期望的改进程度，这似乎是一个具有挑战性的领域。”
“我们会继续努力。车队做得非常好，我们会继续努力缩小差距。”
戴维森：迈凯伦赛车适合高抓地力赛道
“迈凯伦似乎适合高抓地力路面，而这并不是我们在奥斯汀或马来西亚所遇到的情况。他们在像布达佩斯、赞德沃特、马德里这样的中高速弯道上表现更好。
“墨西哥是兰多喜欢的赛道。它不是一条颠簸的赛道，所以让我们看看兰多今年在那里能表现如何。这是他最擅长的赛道之一，去年他在那里统治了比赛。”

detailEn: Mexico City GP: McLaren plan further upgrades after Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri's struggles in Austin

McLaren have confirmed they will continue to upgrade their car in the closing stages of the 2026 Formula 1 season; most teams have stopped development on this year's car to focus on 2027; watch every session of the Mexico City GP from this Friday, live on Sky Sports F1

Craig Slater gives his verdict on the United States GP, as a dominant win for Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli left the Italian needing just two points from the Mexico GP to claim a historic first world title
McLaren plan to bring more upgrades to the car in the remaining rounds of the 2026 Formula 1 season after struggling to compete at the front in recent races.
Since Lando Norris missed out on victory in Madrid last month, McLaren have failed to finish on the podium in the last four races, despite bringing new parts to the car in that period.
After qualifying eighth at last weekend's United States Grand Prix, Norris described the MCL40 as "easily the hardest car I've ever driven in my life".

Norris ran in second place late on in the race by adopting an alternative one-stop strategy but was overtaken late on by Charles Leclerc, Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton as he dropped to fifth, while Oscar Piastri finished seventh.
"There will be some more stuff coming," said team principal Andrea Stella on McLaren's upgrade plans, given most teams are now focusing on designing their 2027 cars.
"I think ultimately we will only be able to do so across Brazil and Vegas. So, Mexico there won't be very much, but Brazil and Vegas there will be some upgrades.

"Hopefully this will help us to be consistently in the fight for podiums and hopefully start to lean on the level of competitiveness that is required to fight for the victory. So, there's a few upgrades that are still in the pipeline."
Charles Leclerc makes two great overtakes on Lando Norris and Max Verstappen in Austin

McLaren confirmed in their press release ahead of this weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix that the team "remains committed to learning, developing and extracting the maximum from the MCL40 at every opportunity".
"After the successful introduction of changes to the front and rear corners of the MCL40 in Austin, the car will remain essentially unchanged going into this weekend's race," they added.

"This will therefore only see a small selection of parts delivered to track in Mexico City through the team's development pathway with further developments in the pipeline for the remaining rounds of the 2026 season, starting from the race in Sao Paulo."
Norris points to qualifying as a weakness
Norris has claimed three pole positions this year in Budapest, Zandvoort and Madrid, but his biggest margin to second place in those qualifying sessions was 0.102s.
The car appears to have been on a knife edge throughout the season, which Piastri has struggled more with, and Norris says the slow-speed corners have also been an issue for the team.
"There's been a lot of races we have shone and done a very good job. Qualifyings we have struggled," Norris told Sky Sports F1.
Norris admits he did a 'terrible job' during Austin qualifying and that the McLaren is the 'hardest car' he has ever driven

"We roughly know where we need to improve the car. I think in Austin it was clear the slow-speed corners we lost almost three tenths a lap, every single lap. That's a chunky bit of lap time to lose so consistently.
"We need to improve in certain areas. If we can do that, I'm very confident we can have some good results but it seems to be a challenging area for us to improve as much as we like.
"We will keep working hard. The team are doing a very good job and we will keep trying to pick away."
Davidson: McLaren car suits high grip tracks
“McLaren seem to suit a high grip surface and that’s not what we had in Austin or Malaysia. They are better on medium to high-speed corners like Budapest, Zandvoort, Madrid.
“Mexico is a track Lando likes. It’s not a bumpy track, so let’s see how Lando can go there this year. It’s one of his best tracks and he dominated last year’s race there.”
